set.body: Specify the semantic contract before changing runtime code. Descriptive transforms and selections perform no IO or numerical work; every view retains one immutable root; chained views compile from that root to the final target; spatial data are interpolated at most once per terminal evaluation; demands may reduce work but not change selected values; unsupported routes, inverse quality, and unavailable data remain typed failures. Acceptance: a durable contract plus shared executable laws cover root identity, composition versus direct evaluation, no eager execution, single-resampling semantics, demand equivalence, cache identity, materialization boundaries, and provenance expectations.
set.title: Spatial lazy contract: freeze root-first semantics and executable laws
